<!doctype html>
<html lang="et">
<head>

<title>Cubie A7A v48.31 – XLR-äärikud −0,4 mm</title>
<style>
  html,body{height:100%;margin:0;background:#111d28;color:#eef5f8;font:14px system-ui,-apple-system,Arial,sans-serif;overflow:hidden}
  #coordsOverlay{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;display:block}
  #view{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;touch-action:none;display:block;cursor:grab}
  #view:active{cursor:grabbing}
  header{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;pointer-events:none;padding:12px 14px;background:linear-gradient(#111d28ef,#111d2800)}
  h1{font-size:16px;margin:0 0 3px;font-weight:650}
  header p{margin:0;font-size:12px;color:#b9d0da}
  #controls{position:absolute;right:12px;bottom:16px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;max-width:min(78vw,450px);justify-content:flex-end;gap:6px}
@media(max-width:520px){#controls{right:8px;bottom:10px;max-width:55vw}#controls button{padding:8px 9px;min-width:40px;min-height:40px;font-size:12px}#legend{max-width:37vw;padding:7px}}
  button{font:inherit;border:1px solid #8aa4b6;border-radius:11px;color:#f4f9fb;background:#263b4be8;padding:10px 14px;min-width:46px;min-height:45px;touch-action:manipulation}
  button:active{background:#466278}
  #legend{position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:15px;max-width:min(56vw,245px);max-height:30vh;overflow:auto;background:#142736d9;border:1px solid #536979;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:11px}
  #legend strong{display:block;margin:0 0 5px}
  .item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;line-height:1.45;cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
  .item.off{opacity:.4;text-decoration:line-through}
  .swatch{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:3px;flex:none;border:1px solid #b8bec280}
  #status{position:absolute;top:56px;left:14px;color:#ffd0a6;background:#182d3dcc;border-radius:5px;padding:3px 6px;display:none}
  @media(max-height:500px){#legend{max-height:40vh}header p{display:none}}

  #sliders{position:absolute;top:93px;right:12px;background:#142736e8;border:1px solid #536979;border-radius:10px;padding:11px 13px;width:min(260px,63vw);display:grid;gap:10px}
  #sliders label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:12px;align-items:center}
  #sliders input{width:100%;accent-color:#75cce8;touch-action:auto}
  @media(max-height:560px){#sliders{top:75px;width:min(220px,50vw);gap:5px;padding:6px 9px}}

header{top:0;padding:9px 12px;background:linear-gradient(#101d2bf5,#101d2bc0,#101d2b00)}
header h1{font-size:14px;line-height:1.25;margin:0 0 4px}
header p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.25;max-width:620px}
#sliders{top:69px;right:9px;left:auto;width:min(240px,62vw);padding:8px 10px;gap:7px;background:#132537dc;box-sizing:border-box}
#sliders label{font-size:11px}
#sliders input{margin:2px 0 1px}
#legend{left:8px;bottom:8px;max-width:44vw;max-height:21vh;box-sizing:border-box;background:#142736d7;padding:7px 9px}
#controls{right:8px;bottom:8px;max-width:48vw;gap:4px}
#controls button{font-size:11px;min-height:34px;min-width:35px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:8px}
#legend strong{font-size:10px}
#items .item{font-size:10px;line-height:1.3}
@media(max-width:520px){
 header p{max-width:33vw;display:block;font-size:10px;line-height:1.22}
 header h1{font-size:13px}
 #sliders{top:69px;width:62vw;max-width:254px}
 #legend{max-width:45vw;max-height:20vh}
 #controls{max-width:49vw}
 #controls button{min-width:34px;min-height:35px;font-size:11px;padding:5px 7px}
}
@media(max-height:560px){header p{display:none}#sliders{top:38px}#legend{max-height:24vh}}


#cupControls{position:absolute;right:9px;top:194px;width:min(240px,62vw);box-sizing:border-box;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:10px;background:#132537e8;border:1px solid #536979;font-size:11px;display:grid;gap:5px}
#cupControls strong{font-size:11px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.2}
#cupControls .cupAx{display:grid;grid-template-columns:45px 1fr;align-items:center;gap:5px}
#cupControls label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px}
#cupControls input{width:100%;accent-color:#f09d48;touch-action:auto}
#cupControls button{touch-action:manipulation}
#dragCup.active{background:#884916;border-color:#ffca79}
@media(max-width:520px){#cupControls{top:190px;width:62vw;max-width:254px;padding:7px 9px}#ubnote{display:none}}
@media(max-height:550px){#cupControls{top:155px;padding:4px 7px;gap:1px}#cupControls input{height:10px}}

/* Separate freehand annotation layer. Original geometry/3D controllers untouched. */
#drawOverlay{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;touch-action:none;z-index:2}
#drawOverlay.drawing{pointer-events:auto;cursor:crosshair}
#controls,#legend,#sliders,#cupControls,#xlrControls,#edgeTabs{z-index:30}
#penToggle[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#71502f;border-color:#ffbf78}
#clearPen[hidden]{display:none !important}
/* v48.15.1: only viewport controls change. CAD mesh and transform code unchanged. */
#edgeTabs { display:none; }
@media (max-width: 900px), (pointer: coarse) {
  header { top:0; left:0; right:0; padding:5px 8px 4px; background:linear-gradient(#111d28ea,#111d2822); z-index:10; }
  header h1 { margin:0; font-size:12px; line-height:1.2; text-align:center; }
  header p, #ubnote { display:none !important; }
  #edgeTabs { display:block; position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:45; pointer-events:none; }
  #edgeTabs button {
    position:absolute; pointer-events:auto; min-width:0; min-height:35px;
    padding:5px 7px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid #526c7e;
    background:#142736ea; font-size:11px; font-weight:600;
    box-shadow:0 2px 5px #0a162584;
  }
  #tabParts {left:2px; top:35px; }
  #tabAppearance {right:2px; top:35px; }
  #tabCup {right:2px; top:76px; }
  #edgeTabs button.is-open { background:#34566b; border-color:#91bbc9; }
  #sliders, #cupControls, #legend {
    display:none; position:absolute; box-sizing:border-box;
    width:min(265px,76vw); max-width:76vw;
    margin:0; box-shadow:0 4px 16px #071421a6;
    background:#142736f5; z-index:40;
    border:1px solid #536979; border-radius:9px;
    padding:9px 10px;
  }
  #sliders.is-open { display:grid; top:76px; right:2px; left:auto; bottom:auto; gap:8px; }
  #cupControls.is-open { display:grid; top:116px; right:2px; left:auto; bottom:auto;
    max-height:calc(100dvh - 168px); overflow-y:auto; gap:6px; }
  #legend.is-open { display:block; top:76px; left:2px; right:auto; bottom:auto;
    max-height:calc(100dvh - 132px); overflow-y:auto; }
  #sliders label, #cupControls label { font-size:11px; }
  #sliders input, #cupControls input { height:22px; }
  #cupControls .cupAx { display:grid; grid-template-columns:42px 1fr; gap:5px; }
  #controls {
    position:absolute; display:flex; box-sizing:border-box;
    left:0; right:0; bottom:0; top:auto;
    width:100%; max-width:none; padding:5px 5px max(5px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    gap:5px; flex-wrap:nowrap; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-start;
    overflow-x:auto; overflow-y:hidden; scrollbar-width:thin;
    background:linear-gradient(#102230dc,#101b28f5); z-index:30;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
  }
  #controls button { flex:0 0 auto; min-height:38px; min-width:38px; padding:5px 9px; font-size:11px; white-space:nowrap; border-radius:8px; }
  #status {top:118px; left:3px; max-width:65vw; z-index:55;}
}
@media (max-width: 900px) and (max-height: 430px), (pointer: coarse) and (max-height: 430px) {
  header { padding:2px 7px; }
  header h1 {font-size:11px;}
  #tabParts, #tabAppearance {top:27px;}
  #tabCup {top:67px;}
  #sliders.is-open, #legend.is-open {top:68px;}
  #cupControls.is-open {top:107px; max-height:calc(100dvh - 160px);}
  #controls {padding-top:3px;}
  #controls button {min-height:32px;}
}

/* v48.18: original whole manufactured solid, no displaceable cup controls */
#tabCup,#cupControls,#dragCup{display:none !important}
#edgeTabs{pointer-events:none}
#edgeTabs #tabParts,#edgeTabs #tabAppearance{pointer-events:auto}

/* XLR placement controls use the existing edge-panel layout. */
#edgeTabs #tabXlr{pointer-events:auto;position:absolute;right:2px;top:76px;z-index:45;font-size:11px;min-height:35px;padding:5px 9px}
#xlrControls{display:none;position:absolute;right:2px;top:116px;z-index:40;width:min(305px,calc(100vw - 4px));max-height:calc(100dvh - 172px);overflow:auto;box-sizing:border-box;background:#142736f5;border:1px solid #536979;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;color:#eef5f8;font-size:12px}
#xlrControls.is-open{display:block}.xlrSelect{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:9px}.xlrSelect button{flex:1;min-height:34px;padding:5px}.xlrSelect button.selected{background:#56636d;border-color:#ddd}.xlrAxis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:95px 1fr 62px;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin:7px 0}.xlrAxis input[type=range]{width:100%;min-width:0}.xlrAxis input[type=number]{width:62px;box-sizing:border-box;background:#253c4b;border:1px solid #68808f;color:#fff;border-radius:5px;padding:5px;font:inherit}.xlrNote{font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;color:#c3cbd0;margin:8px 0}.xlrActions{display:flex;gap:6px}.xlrActions button{flex:1;min-height:33px;padding:4px;font-size:11px}#xlrSummary{white-space:pre-line;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;margin:8px 0}#xlrExport{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;margin-top:8px;min-height:125px;font:11px monospace;background:#152735;color:#eee}
@media(max-height:560px){#edgeTabs #tabXlr{top:67px}#xlrControls{top:107px;max-height:calc(100dvh - 150px)}}

/* Desktop: expose the XLR tab without changing the mobile edge controls. */
@media (min-width:901px) and (pointer:fine) {
  #edgeTabs { display:contents; }
  #edgeTabs > button:not(#tabXlr) { display:none; }
  #edgeTabs #tabXlr { top:24px; }
  #xlrControls { top:69px; max-height:calc(100dvh - 125px); }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="view" aria-label="Pööratav CAD 3D-mudel"></canvas>
<canvas id="coordsOverlay" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
<canvas id="drawOverlay" aria-label="Joonistamiskiht"></canvas>
<header><h1>Cubie A7A · esipaneel + kopsik ühest tükist</h1><p>V48.31 · XLR-äärikud −0,4 mm, Z5 mm · CAD-union · kalle 16°, Z +3,5 mm · USB-pesad eemaldatud</p></header>
<div id="ubnote" style="position:absolute;top:52px;left:12px;max-width:38vw;font-size:10px;line-height:1.25;background:#0f2638dc;padding:5px 7px;border-radius:7px;pointer-events:none">Kopsik on esipaneeliga üheks tahkeks detailiks liidetud. Waveshare pööratav rõngas on väljaspool; paikne alus ja USB-moodul on eraldi kuvatavad. USB-pesad on eemaldatud.</div>
<div id="edgeTabs" aria-label="Mobiili juhtpaneelid">
  <button id="tabParts" type="button" aria-controls="legend" aria-expanded="false">Osad ▸</button>
  <button id="tabAppearance" type="button" aria-controls="sliders" aria-expanded="false">Vaade ◂</button>
  <button id="tabXlr" type="button" aria-controls="xlrControls" aria-expanded="false">XLR ◂</button>
  <button id="tabCup" type="button" aria-controls="cupControls" aria-expanded="false">Koost ◂</button>
</div>
<div id="xlrControls"><div class="xlrSelect"><button type="button" data-select-xlr="xlr1">Vasak XLR</button><button type="button" data-select-xlr="xlr2">Parem XLR</button></div><div class="xlrAxis"><label for="xlrX">X, mm</label><input type="range" id="xlrX" min="-30" max="200" step="0.1"><input type="number" id="xlrXNumber" min="-30" max="200" step="0.1" aria-label="X, mm"></div><div class="xlrAxis"><label for="xlrY">Y, mm</label><input type="range" id="xlrY" min="-30" max="130" step="0.1"><input type="number" id="xlrYNumber" min="-30" max="130" step="0.1" aria-label="Y, mm"></div><div class="xlrAxis"><label for="xlrZ">Sügavus, mm</label><input type="range" id="xlrZ" min="-30" max="80" step="0.1"><input type="number" id="xlrZNumber" min="-30" max="80" step="0.1" aria-label="Sügavus, mm"></div><div class="xlrAxis"><label for="xlrRX">Kalle X, °</label><input type="range" id="xlrRX" min="-180" max="180" step="0.1"><input type="number" id="xlrRXNumber" min="-180" max="180" step="0.1" aria-label="Kalle X, °"></div><div class="xlrAxis"><label for="xlrRY">Kalle Y, °</label><input type="range" id="xlrRY" min="-180" max="180" step="0.1"><input type="number" id="xlrRYNumber" min="-180" max="180" step="0.1" aria-label="Kalle Y, °"></div><div class="xlrAxis"><label for="xlrRZ">Pööre, °</label><input type="range" id="xlrRZ" min="-180" max="180" step="0.1"><input type="number" id="xlrRZNumber" min="-180" max="180" step="0.1" aria-label="Pööre, °"></div><div id="xlrSummary"></div><p class="xlrNote">Paigutus piltide järgi; mõlema sügavus Z=5 mm ja pööre 180°. XLR-ide küljed ja põhi on kärbitud paneeli väliskontuurini, kopsikusse ulatuv materjal eemaldatud. Mõlema XLR-i vastasäärikult eemaldatud 0,4 mm; omavaheline kattumine eemaldatud. Kopsik ja paneel säilivad tervikuna. Paneeli XLR-avasid veel ei lõigata. Pesa sisemised õõnsused ja klemmide ristlõige on lihtsustatud.</p><div class="xlrActions"><button id="xlrReset">Valitud algasend</button><button id="xlrCopy">Kopeeri asukohad</button></div><textarea id="xlrExport" readonly hidden aria-label="XLR-ide asukohad"></textarea></div>
<div id="sliders"><div><label for="alphaSlider">Paneeli läbipaistvus <output id="alphaValue">0%</output></label><input type="range" id="alphaSlider" min="0" max="100" value="0" step="1" aria-label="Paneeli läbipaistvus"></div><div><label for="gridSlider">Ruudustiku nähtavus <output id="gridValue">0%</output></label><input type="range" id="gridSlider" min="0" max="100" value="0" step="1" aria-label="Ruudustiku nähtavus"></div></div>
<div id="cupControls"><strong>CAD-kinnitus · fikseeritud asend</strong><div class="cupAx"><label>X <output id="cupXOut">0</output></label><input type="range" id="cupX" min="-35" max="35" value="0" step="0.5"></div><div class="cupAx"><label>Y <output id="cupYOut">0</output></label><input type="range" id="cupY" min="-35" max="35" value="0" step="0.5"></div><div class="cupAx"><label>Z <output id="cupZOut">3.5</output></label><input type="range" id="cupZ" min="-15" max="25" value="3.5" step="0.5"></div><div class="cupAx"><label>Kalle <output id="cupTiltOut">16°</output></label><input type="range" id="cupTilt" min="0" max="60" value="16" step="1"></div><button id="cupReset" style="min-height:30px;padding:4px;font-size:11px">Koost algasendisse</button></div><div id="status"></div>
<div id="legend"><strong>1 mm võrk · eraldi osad (klõps peidab)</strong><div id="items"></div></div>
<div id="controls"><button id="photoShare" type="button">📷 Foto</button><button id="penToggle" type="button" aria-pressed="false">✎ Pliiats</button><button id="clearPen" type="button" hidden>Kustuta joon</button><button id="minus" aria-label="Vähenda">−</button><button id="plus" aria-label="Suurenda">+</button><button id="coords">Mõõdud: väljas</button><button id="dragCup" aria-label="Tassi nihutamine">Kopsik on liidetud</button><button id="front">Eest</button><button id="waveAxis">Wave otse</button><button id="back">Tagant</button><button id="side">Küljelt</button><button id="top">Ülalt</button><button id="reset">Lähtesta</button></div>
<script>
'use strict';
// Offline structural mesh comes from ONE verified, watertight CGAL STL
// exported from v48 .scad. All structural features are a single part.
// Optional glass, savers and pins are nonstructural display-only overlays,
// retained from previous viewer, initially hidden.
const geometry=[{"name":"Konstruktsioon · v48.26 · AUX ja kõrvaklapipesad eemaldatud","hex":"#b7b7b7","triangles":71880,"q":"
